page.overview:
Who is Suicune?

Suicune is a leopard-like creature, sky blue in color, with white rhombuses around the body and a white belly. Suicune has an aquamarine crest on its head which is in the shape of a hexagram. Behind its crest is a purple mane with supposedly thick, smooth fur. Two white, ribbon-like tails sprout out from Suicune's back and In reverse. A shiny Suicune is light blue, with a dark blue crest and a cerulean blue mane.

Suicune has an ancient ancestor known as Walking Wake.

In , a level 50 Suicune begins to roam around Kanto if the player character's First partner Pokémon was Charmander and they have won against the Elite Four. Suicune is very hard to catch, because it will flee unless the player sends out a Pokémon with the ability Shadow Tag or the move Mean Look.

In , a level 40 Suicune roams around Johto and Kanto. It is first located in the Burned Tower, but can be battled at Route 25 only after pursuing through a few other locations.
